title: EnvironmentRunReceipt
description: Mandatory PROVENANCE of one environment run: which environment ran which agent for which tenant, the input/output content hashes (so the measured artifacts are tamper-evident and de-duplicable), the RewardResult it produced, start/complete timestamps, and the policy checks that gated the run (e.g. network_denied, secrets_denied, steps_bounded, timeout_enforced, local_equivalent_used). The receipt records WHAT WAS MEASURED; it never asserts the agent output is true. No raw secrets — hashes and check booleans only.

input_hash.description: canonical hash of the run input (tamper-evident; not the raw input)

output_hash.description: canonical hash of the agent output (tamper-evident; not the raw output)

reward_result_id.description: id of the RewardResult measured for this run; null when no scoring occurred

policy_checks.description: the governance checks enforced for this run, e.g. {network_denied, secrets_denied, steps_bounded, timeout_enforced, local_equivalent_used} -> booleans
